base_member_text: TRIDy_periodic loops L154-L156 and L160-L162 use lowercase loop variable i but index c_end(I)/a_beg(I) with uppercase I — the same identifier in Fortran, so consistent, but beta loops L251/L277 likewise mix beta(i) with c_end(I); the equations rely on i==I identity

TRIDx/TRIDy modify dummy arguments a,c,d in place without INTENT declarations (L312, L399); TRIDy_periodic's comment @L168 documents that c,d are 'trashed' — callers must pass copies (c1=c @L171 protects only the first pass)

TRIDx forward-sweep guard 'if (a(i,j).ne.ZERO)' (L323, L333, L411, L421) leaves c,d unmodified where a==ZERO — the meaning of a zero sub-diagonal row (boundary rows?) is established by the callers, not this file

TRIDy_periodic: the two-rank exchanges (L104-L141, L214-L246) use blocking MPI_SEND before the matching IRECV is guaranteed posted on the peer — correctness relies on eager delivery for Mloc-sized messages when ProcessorID(II,1)==ProcessorID(II,PY) ranks differ; when PY==1 both branches are skipped and a_beg/c_end are copied locally (L144-L147) only over Ibeg:Iend while the parallel path copies 1:Mloc
Sequential dependency: TRIDx/TRIDy pipeline ranks — each rank waits for its west/south neighbor's seed before sweeping (L318-L328, L406-L417), serializing across the processor row/column

Unused declarations: nreq,ll,JJ @L80, myvar,mybeta @L84, Axx,Cxx,Dxx,U1D @L89, rmsg,smsg @L90 (in TRIDy_periodic), commented '! integer i, j' @L402; loop indices i,j,I,J are PARAM module variables (no local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE)
Header of TRIDy (L385) says 'TRIDx is parallel version...' — copy-paste; file name 'tridiagnal' is itself a misspelling of tridiagonal

audit_member_text: TRIDy_periodic divides by 1+c_end and 1+a_beg at lines 154-161 and 190-196, and by the Sherman-Morrison correction denominator at lines 251-252 and 277-278, without testing those denominators for zero or near-zero; singular periodic systems can therefore produce division by zero despite the algorithm comments at lines 57-62.

TRIDx and TRIDy test only a(...).ne.ZERO at lines 323 and 333 or 411 and 421, but then divide by the distinct eliminated pivot 1/a-rmsg(:,2) or 1/a-c(previous) at lines 324-326, 334-336, 412-414, and 422-424; the zero test does not protect against a zero eliminated pivot.

The backward phase fills only smsg(:,1) at lines 373-375 and 460-463 but MPI_ISEND transmits 2*Nloc or 2*Mloc values at lines 376-377 and 464-465. Thus smsg(:,2) is stale or uninitialized while receivers request the same two-column count at lines 354-355 and 442-443; current receivers use only column 1, but the communicated interface and initialized payload do not match.

All three routines use loop indices i and j under IMPLICIT NONE (lines 77, 310, 397), while no active local declarations for i or j appear (the only visible candidate is commented out at line 402). Successful compilation therefore depends on USE PARAM or another use-associated module exporting mutable i/j names, an implicit cross-module coupling not established in this file.

TRIDy_periodic sends all Mloc beta entries at line 259 after assigning only Ibeg:Iend at lines 250-254, and receivers copy all 1:Mloc entries at lines 266-268; halo entries outside the interior range can carry uninitialized data even though subsequent solution loops currently consume only Ibeg:Iend at lines 283-287.
